ops.reason: REFUNDS/NFR-05 asks that customers and branch managers do not wait during everyday actions and leaves the seconds open; 2 seconds at P99 is a responsive ceiling for entering a receipt number, submitting a request or opening a list.
No LOYALTY source gives a response time; the same everyday-action ceiling as the refund journeys keeps one screen target for the platform.
REFUNDS/NFR-02 allows no more than 2 hours of disruption a month, planned maintenance included; 99.9% keeps the monthly downtime the engine computes inside that limit.
LOYALTY/NFR-04 asks for the points screens at any time of day, every day, and leaves the minutes open; the target of the refund journeys keeps one availability target for the platform.
REFUNDS/NFR-02 allows 2 hours of disruption a month in total; a recovery inside 1 hour leaves room for planned maintenance in the same month.
REFUNDS/NFR-01: refund money is never lost or paid twice, so an accepted decision or payout result must not be lost.
